name: authoring-abort-needs-reground-retry
description: Structured generator abort: pass one aborts naming the missing response shape of one connector route in `needs`. The engine re-grounds that route's recorded shape and runs exactly one more pass whose prompt carries the fetched evidence; the second pass succeeds and the draft is stashed. A need the engine cannot ground returns the needs and a concrete evidence action instead of a blind identical retry. No live HTTP fires.
failure_class: generator abort with free-text reason retried with identical grounding

input.goal: Every morning list yesterday's open orders with their totals.

abort.reason: the response shape of the orders listing is not in the excerpt

expect.evidence_heading: Evidence fetched for the previous abort
